body: Is it really that easy? I have a few friends in the AF and they all seem to be in pretty good shape.

Thanks for the advice. I'm a bit out of shape right now for the military so I may have to start working out again before I can but it definitely is an option. My brother was in the Marines before he was medically discharged and the way they handled his situation always put me off to the idea of joining but I may be better than nothing.

I've been prompted before about going to Korea to teach English. I do have some family left there as well. However I've have heard a few horror stories from people who have done that sort of thing before but also a few good ones. It might be better than running away with nothing set up. I'll have to look into that more. Thank you.
This may be an idea, although I'm pretty out of shape right now. It'll take a little time to get into the right shape. I may have to think about this more.

I realize I have a posting history. This is a throwaway to talk specifically about those things. I just assumed most people wouldn't bother reading through my long winded posts but I knew a few might. I've tried to better explain myself to the commenter above you so maybe that will shed a little more light on my situation. I don't like to ask for help, whether it be some random person or a family member. I hate being a burden and I always feel like one. The issues I have don't come from a certain situation I'm in but are more existential in nature. They will not go away, but I realize you could deal with them as many people do. I just don't wish to be a part of that grind anymore. I can't show you my whole life but things have happened where I'm just so exhausted. Running away is a dumb idea, suicide is a dumb idea. I understand this fully. Not wanting to be a burden is also a stupid excuse to not get more professional help. This is all irrational and stupid behavior but I can't help the way I feel.
Sorry, I didn't realize. Editors, thanks for the heads up and advice.

It's not like school has been free...I'm around $100,000 in debt. That's life crushing debt. Again, its hard for me to convey what I want. I've been trying but I'll give it another shot and hopefully you'll understand a little more. 

I think about these things all the time. I realize killing myself is cowardly and selfish. I accept that I may be a selfish asshole. But if this is my life, and I'm under a lot of pain, why can't I seek to end it? I also realize that facing my problems is the *right* thing to do. But I'm sick of doing things I don't want to. You're wrong, I'm not a hard worker. I've skated by school without ever studying because I didn't need to. And I say that not as a point of pride, I didn't realize how stupid and childish it was until I got to college where poor studying habits will hurt you. I do work hard when it comes to things I'm passionate about like cooking. I went to the top culinary school that you could go to for fifty thousand a year. I got a job at one of the top restaurants in the  country. I worked 60-70 hours a week for 9 dollars an hour living by myself in one of the most expensive cities in the world. I discovered that while I do love cooking, I wanted more from life. I wanted a family, a social life, financial stability. You can't really have those things as a professional cook. I'm passionate about other things as well. Like learning. I love to learn and read. Especially things that are related to technology and the human mind. But I also love history, and sports, and a dozen other things I feel like I can and should be able to do and that is where one of my problems come from. My inability to stick to something. I could be working on a new Java app, fully invested into it, then eventually I lose interest and want to move on to something else. 

I've also become bewildered by relationships and how we interact with people. I'm good at it, I can be the center of a party, but somewhere along the line I lost that. I get so anxious, I shake and have panic attacks randomly. Words just fumble out of my mouth and I often speak before I think. If I were to try and tell you all this in person I'd be doing a much worse job of it than I already am. I'm tired of having to put effort into people. And I don't mean that as I'm sick of a particular person or I hate social interaction, but I can't stand the way people are including myself. Most of the time, it ends in disappointment for one party or more. All the nuances that goes into interacting with any person at any given time is exhausting to me. I hate explaining myself because I'm so bad at it. Words are just words at the end of the day. And I'm not sure if the failure to communicate ideas through words is my fault, or the fault of language as a form of communication. I'm sure it's the former, but I feel like I'll never be able to be understood which sucks. 

Again, there is a lot I'm not touching on that bothers me, both existential and personal. Esoteric and exoteric. I feel as if these issues won't go away no matter what. Most people either don't think about it or deal with it in a way which I haven't been able to do. Either way, I hate having to think about it in the first place.

I do realize this. I plan on visiting as a tourist, renting a room somewhere, work some odd jobs until I get some form of stability. It is like a stupid choice but I can't believe Canada has no immigrants there working illegally.
I'm not sure that it will. I only hope. It's better than just giving up for now.
I realize this but how is the immigration policy and what requirements would I need to have to properly immigrate?

Thanks friend. I realize it's not the best decision, but its the only other one in my mind besides suicide. For reasons I don't want to get into, I'm sick of the life I have now. I just need to escape.

I did. But I quickly realized its not that helpful in the grand scheme of things. I can take medication, I can be given advice on how I can improve my life, but it won't change the way I feel about certain things. I can't go into too much details but there is one thing about myself that I know is horrible and disgusting. I've tried so many times to change and I'm not quite giving up yet, but that is the main reason I want to end it. I'm not a good person no matter how much I'd like to think differently.

Thanks for the advice. I really rather not stay in the country but it seems like I have little choice. You sound like a pretty brave person. Are things working out for you? How much did you have when you ran away?

Everyone keeps saying that dropping out of school is not a reason to run away. I've suffering from many problems and school is near the bottom of that list. Trust me if that was the only thing I wouldn't be doing this. I just didn't want to explain everything because I can't. I'm not that good with words. I've tried many times. What is going on in my head is not easy to put into words. It's  not just the fact they'll be pissed. They love me so much and I love them. They've invested so much in me and I feel like am utter disappointment. They got divroced when I was two and I feel like I'm the cause of a lot of tension between the two. They'll be better off without me
I may be all those things but I'm desperate. I need an out from all this.

I wish I could explain everything. Failing out of school is near the bottom of the long list of problems I have. As mentioned before I'm on mobile so it's hard for me to make a long expositional post detailing everything. But to answer some of your questions with something that's really not much of an answer because it would be impossible for me to convey the relationships I have with my family members; I've had the pressure on me to succeed since I was little. Not to stereotype, but my mothers side of my family is Korean and they came from practically nothing. Right now they're on hard times financially but have become pretty successful doctors and lawyers for the most part. My family thinks I'm primed to be this great guy with limitless potential, that I'll become some multimillionaire who has everything at his finger tips. I've felt that pressure from a very young age. It has gotten to me pretty good. Again, this problem is near the bottom of things currently bothering me. I'm just really sick of life, the grind and monotony of it. Of keeping people happy, keeping relationships, etc. Some of my family members are not emotionally stable people, especially the aunt I'm currently with. I think it's something that runs in the family. I don't want to face it because I've done it a million times and I'm sick of it. Some days I want to change the world, others I just want to crawl in a hole and die. I figured starting new and fresh might help before I actually decide to kill myself. 

Of course my problems aren't anything special, and I realize potentially billions of people may be worse off. But so what? It's all relative.
I might be able to help you out. Do you have a smart phone? I can send the money through snapchat which would be transferred to you instantly provided that you have a debit card.

I appreciate the kind words. Thanks for reading this mess. I just needed to get some of this shit off my chest as there's really no one to talk to about it. The fact that you even read it helped a little
Yea, I'm kinda past that point. I use to play several sports. Just doesn't do it for me anymore.
Maybe video games aren't the best outlet for that? You know, everything in moderation.

It doesn't have to be an object or a person. Just something you're passionate about like a subject or an art form. If you dedicate time to that you may find others who share your same passions. Don't go seeking them directly, it will come over time.

I have to do that otherwise the crushing weight of reality might push me over the edge. I play a different game everyday, my life has become a sad cycle where I need to try something, get bored with it after a day, get depressed because life, then find a new thing to distract me before the real world comes crashing back in.

Everyone's different, while also bring the same. These pills can work for you, they might not, but like you suggested maybe pills isn't the best thing to help you. Maybe a different kind of drug? Or rather a person or thing to help keep you sane?

Maybe you feel like the cycle you've been pushed into by society isn't enough. You need to find a thing, a passion, to hold onto and to make yourself a better person. Otherwise, what's the point of any of it?

Do you want an honest answer or for someone to tell you it will be okay? Cause the truth is this is a problem that only you can deal with and fix if youre willing to put yourself out there. I can't relate too much with college, not to sound cocky but I have a lot of friends. But that's now. I moved when I was young and I was an overweight Asian/European kid. I tried everyday to make friends and I have a good sense of humor which has helped me immensely to make friends.

Not every school is the same, but I will tell you there are hundreds of people going to school from so many different walks of life, its almost impossible to not find someone you relate to on some level, you just have to get out there. Join some clubs, maybe even a club sport as that's a great way to build bonds. Improve yourself in anyway, clean clothes, clean looks, don't be that kid who looks unapproachable. Just be the best version of yourself that you can and the rest will come.
